text:
Sebastian Aho is a year removed from a Stanley Cup and playing like a center who wants another. He has 26 points in 19 games, hit a pair of franchise milestones against Chicago, and is off to the best faceoff start of his career. Carolina gets 61% of the expected goals at five on five with him on the ice, which is a dominant number even for a team built to dominate.

Some of the scoring is borrowed. The Hurricanes have scored 5.5 more goals than expected with him out there, and his own shooting is 18.5% against a usual range around 14%. Expect the pace to come down from 4.1 points per 60 minutes toward the low 3s, which is still first-line production.

Evolving-Hockey had him 16th among 401 forwards last season, driving play at the 94th percentile even after adjusting for good teammates. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking flags one habit to watch: plenty of shot attempts, fewer from the slot than his volume suggests. When he gets inside, the totals follow.
headline: Aho is winning the faceoff chess match
